snippets.title: Inspect the selected evidence
snippets.code:
from historical_lab import Query, explain, load_fixture
ledger = load_fixture()
for cutoff in (600, 610):
    trace = explain(ledger, Query("C1", 540, 600, cutoff))
    chosen = [(r["event_id"], r["revision"]) for r in trace["selected"]]
    print(cutoff, chosen)
print(trace["selected"][-1]["reason"])

snippets.title: Select eligible versions in SQLite
snippets.code:
WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT * FROM revisions WHERE available_at <= :known_at
), ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY revision DESC
    ) AS position
    FROM eligible
), selected AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE position = 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN :history_known = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) END AS spend
FROM selected
WHERE customer_id = :customer_id
  AND event_time >= :window_start
  AND event_time < :window_end
  AND op = 'upsert'
  AND :history_known = 1;

snippets.title: Select tombstones before filtering operations
snippets.code:
from historical_lab import Query, explain, load_fixture, sqlite_value
ledger = load_fixture("deletion_extension")
query = Query("C1", 540, 600, 620)
trace = explain(ledger, query)
print([(r["event_id"], r["revision"], r["op"])
       for r in trace["selected"] if r["event_id"] == "C"])
print(trace["value"], sqlite_value(ledger, query))
print(sqlite_value(ledger, Query("C1", 540, 600, 600)))

snippets.title: Preserve the coverage distinction
snippets.code:
from historical_lab import Query, load_fixture, reference_value, sqlite_value
ledger = load_fixture()
for known in (True, False):
    query = Query("C9", 540, 600, 600, history_known=known)
    print(reference_value(ledger, query), sqlite_value(ledger, query))

snippets.title: Replaying delivery evidence preserves history
snippets.code:
from foundations_lab import Delivery, Ledger, ingest
from historical_lab import Query, load_fixture, sqlite_value
ledger = load_fixture()
retry = Delivery("a1-later", ledger.history[0], delivered_at=609)
replayed = ingest(ledger, [retry, retry])
reversed_log = Ledger(tuple(reversed(replayed.deliveries)))
print(replayed.history == ledger.history)
print(reversed_log == replayed)
print(sqlite_value(reversed_log, Query("C1", 540, 600, 600)))
